description: This file defines a Retrofit-based implementation of the NiaNetworkDataSource interface for the Now in Android project. It includes API endpoint declarations, data models, and a class that initializes Retrofit with JSON serialization and provides methods to fetch topics, news resources, and change lists from the backend.

classes.name: RetrofitNiaNetworkApi
classes.description: Private interface defining Retrofit API endpoints for fetching topics, news resources, and change lists.

classes.name: NetworkResponse
classes.description: Generic data wrapper class for API responses, serializable with kotlinx.serialization.

classes.name: RetrofitNiaNetwork
classes.description: Singleton class implementing NiaNetworkDataSource using Retrofit, providing methods to fetch data from the backend.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches a list of NetworkTopic objects for given IDs.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Fetches a list of NetworkNewsResource objects for given IDs.

methods.name: getTopicChangeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of NetworkChangeList objects representing topic changes after a specified point.

methods.name: getNewsResourceChangeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of NetworkChangeList objects representing news resource changes after a specified point.
